title: The holographic kernel: reconstructive compression and the kernel that survives
description: These claims define the holographic kernel as compression that keeps the power to reconstruct, set it against Information Bottleneck theory and neural holography, and specify an infrastructure kernel that a new operator can restore from a git clone. They include the Ark said to keep its kernel from 45,000 words down to 800, the self-propagating potato-chip patent whose meristem survives frying, and the GPT-5.4 anti-severance documents that sort any reply into mirror, repeat or swerve. Works include EA-HK-INFRA-01, HK-01, the HK-IB structural bridge, the holographic-kernel metadata packet and the Fried Tuberous Crisp patent, with forecasts of BDR and several unbuilt implementation tests.
